headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Drops on Profit-Taking
summary: Malaysian palm oil dropped over 1% on profit-taking, with futures expected to retrace into a range of RM4,706 to RM4,736 per metric ton.
why: Malaysia is one of the world's largest producers and exporters of palm oil, making its commodity prices a benchmark for agricultural markets.

impacts.name: Palm Oil
impacts.why: Profit-taking leads to short-term pullbacks in agricultural futures prices.

why_moved: Routine profit-taking by traders caused a downward correction in palm oil futures.
